==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I visited a self-service magic milkshake bar. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
I was warned by Felicia not to drink a Meta Shake, as it might boost my power into an uncontrollable state. (Felicia is a tan skinned elf woman with green eyes, pointed ears, and long black hair. She has an hourglass figure and wears a black leather cat suit with a white fur collar. She wears black lace up boots.)
Felicia drank one and it allowed her to become a Were-Cat. (Were-Cat Felicia is a humanoid black cat woman with green eyes and long black hair. She has an hourglass figure and wears a black leather cat suit with a white fur collar. She wears black lace up boots.)
